summary: Design attention through foreground, focal action and background separation instead of relying solely on glow or dark exposure.
objective: The focal action stays visible throughout the move, text remains readable and dramatic darkness does not hide the mechanism being explained.
intent_signals: Direct attention with framing light and a purposeful reveal
example_prompts: Stage a cinematic reveal of a mechanical watch, then let me inspect its moving parts.

principles: Design attention through foreground, focal action and background separation instead of relying solely on glow or dark exposure.
implementation: Arrange depth layers and purposeful negative space around the hero silhouette; keep foreground shapes from blocking required actions.
Use motivated-looking key and accent lights with a chosen contrast range; retain detail needed to understand the scene.
Plan a revealing camera move or hold, with a stable inspection view available for interactive tasks; time visual emphasis around a meaningful action.
Frame 2.39:1 with hard mattes at fov 28-35 degrees and keep every control, label and required action inside the centre 80%, so a 16:9 fallback crop remains usable.

Run key:fill at 8:1 (SpotLight 40 candela against a 0.25 HemisphereLight), vignette 0.35 and grain 0.06 under ACESFilmic at exposure 0.85; confirm in a grayscale screenshot that the mechanism under explanation still reads at that contrast.
observable_checks: The focal action stays visible throughout the move, text remains readable and dramatic darkness does not hide the mechanism being explained.

defaults.rationale: Cinematic staging is a contrast budget, so the numbers spend it in one place: a 60/30/10 value split, an 8:1 key-to-fill ratio and a single region above 0.8 luminance on the hero, with a cool rim from the opposite quadrant doing the separation that a fill light would otherwise flatten. The 2.39:1 frame at 28-35 degrees and exposure 0.85 buy negative space and shadow depth, while vignette 0.35 and grain 0.06 keep the darkness textured rather than crushed.

values.value_structure: 60/30/10 dark/mid/light; the hero face or focal mechanism owns the only region above 0.8 luminance
values.saturation_rule: background <= 30% HSL, hero <= 65%; at most two hue families (warm key, cool rim) plus the single accent

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 8:1 measured on a neutral card at the hero; the rim sits between them so the contour never merges with the background

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

camera.aspect_ratio: 2.39:1 with hard mattes; compose the action inside the centre 80% for a 16:9 fallback

materials.notes: exactly one wet or polished surface in frame to carry the key as a specular streak; every other surface stays at or above 0.55 roughness so that highlight remains unique

post.dof: hero in focus at f/2.0; disable while the user is orbiting

values.signature_technique: a motivated single key at 8:1 with a cool rim from the opposite quadrant, framed 2.39:1 so the negative space above the hero carries the tension
never: a flat frontal key mounted at the camera
letterboxing with no depth layers behind the hero
dramatic darkness that hides the mechanism being explained

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at exposure 0.85; re-tune every intensity, fog density and bloom threshold if you change the tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with photorealistic, stylized or miniature subjects; cinematic is staging rather than a promise of a specific rendering technology.
